name: YouTube Studio Hub
description: Connect one or more Google accounts and manage every YouTube channel they own from one place: content metadata, analytics, channel management (playlists/comments), and content ideas. Does not edit, trim, or re-encode video files -- that stays in YouTube Studio.

tools.name: connect_account
tools.description: Get the Google authorization link to connect a YouTube account.

tools.name: list_accounts
tools.description: List connected Google accounts and connection state.

refresh.description: Verify each account against the YouTube Data API
refresh.title: Refresh

tools.name: disconnect_account
tools.description: Disconnect a Google account. Its local YouTube Studio Hub data (saved ideas) is removed; nothing on YouTube itself changes.

account_id.description: Stable id of the connected Google account to disconnect
account_id.title: Account Id

tools.name: switch_account
tools.description: Change the active Google account used by default.

account.description: Connected Google account email to make active
account.title: Account

tools.name: save_app_setting
tools.description: Save an app-wide YouTube Studio Hub setting (e.g. whether Content Ideas may use AI generation).

ai_ideas_enabled.description: Whether Content Ideas may use AI generation
ai_ideas_enabled.title: Ai Ideas Enabled

tools.name: list_channels
tools.description: List every YouTube channel reachable from connected Google account(s).

account.description: Connected Google account email. Omit when only one account is connected.
account.title: Account

tools.name: get_channel
tools.description: Read one YouTube channel's profile and stats.

tools.name: list_channel_videos
tools.description: List videos uploaded to one YouTube channel (My Content tab).

page_token.description: Continuation token from the previous page
page_token.title: Page Token

tools.name: get_video
tools.description: Read one video's full metadata and stats.

tools.name: update_video_metadata
tools.description: Update a video's title, description, tags, category, or visibility (no editing/trimming of the video file itself).

title.description: New title; empty keeps the current title
title.title: Title

description.description: New description; empty keeps the current description
description.title: Description

tags.description: Replacement tag list; empty list keeps current tags
tags.title: Tags

category_id.description: YouTube video category id; empty keeps the current category
category_id.title: Category Id

visibility.description: private, unlisted, or public; empty keeps current visibility
visibility.title: Visibility

tools.name: set_video_thumbnail
tools.description: Replace a video's custom thumbnail image.

image_url.description: Publicly reachable https:// image URL to set as the thumbnail
image_url.title: Image Url

tools.name: get_channel_analytics
tools.description: Read channel-level YouTube Analytics: views, watch time, subscribers gained/lost, over a date range.

tools.name: get_video_analytics
tools.description: Read video-level YouTube Analytics: views, watch time, average view duration, likes, for one video.

channel_id.description: Owning channel id (Analytics API requires it for the filter)
channel_id.title: Channel Id

tools.name: get_top_videos
tools.description: Read a channel's top videos by views over a date range -- helps spot what is/isn't growing.

tools.name: get_traffic_sources
tools.description: Read where a channel's views come from (search, suggested, external, playlists, etc.) over a date range.

tools.name: list_channel_playlists
tools.description: List a channel's playlists (Channel Management tab).

tools.name: list_playlist_items
tools.description: List the videos inside one playlist.

tools.name: list_comments
tools.description: List recent comments on one video, for moderation (Channel Management tab).

tools.name: reply_to_comment
tools.description: Post a reply to a comment thread, as the connected YouTube channel.

comment_thread_id.description: Top-level comment/thread id to reply under
comment_thread_id.title: Comment Thread Id

tools.name: moderate_comment
tools.description: Set a comment's moderation status: published, held for review, or rejected.

tools.name: save_content_idea
tools.description: Save a content idea/SEO note for a channel -- title direction, target keyword, and why it might work.

channel_id.description: YouTube channel id this idea is for
channel_id.title: Channel Id

tools.name: list_content_ideas
tools.description: List saved content ideas for a channel (Content Ideas tab).

tools.name: generate_content_ideas
tools.description: Ask the AI to draft new content ideas for a channel, grounded in its recent top-performing videos and traffic sources -- helps answer 'what should I film next'.

channel_title.description: Channel title, used to ground the AI prompt
channel_title.title: Channel Title

context.description: Extra creator context/direction for idea generation
context.title: Context

tools.name: update_idea_status
tools.description: Move a content idea to a new status: idea, planned, filmed, or done.

tools.name: delete_idea
tools.description: Permanently delete a saved content idea.

idea_id.description: Content idea id to permanently delete
idea_id.title: Idea Id

secrets.name: google_client_id
secrets.description: Google OAuth client ID for YouTube Studio Hub.

secrets.name: google_client_secret
secrets.description: Google OAuth client secret for YouTube Studio Hub.
